problem_statement:
Use GUI, The precondition FreeCAD file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file in FreeCAD and finish the CAM setup for the target part.

A precondition stock is provided. Use it to cut the target shape. Do not change the stock position, dimensions, or material, because the bottom button also needs to be cut. You may create multiple CAM jobs or setups if the part needs to be flipped.

The precondition file includes the stock/material block. Do not modify the target shape or any supplied Stock object, including its dimensions, position, and material. Multiple CAM jobs/setups are allowed when needed to machine both sides or reach leftover material.

Generate the CAM operation toolpaths and save the completed FreeCAD document to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd. The saved .FCStd file must include generated CAM path data.

Workspace integration: the initial file is Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd; save the final document as output/Unnamed.FCStd.
